text: API keys are scoped to a single agent (Buyer or Seller) and managed per-agent in the dashboard
quote: API keys are created and managed in your Agent Dashboard, and each key is scoped to a single agent (Buyer or Seller).

text: Developers can create tokens directly via the Playground or API with pre-filled parameters
quote: Create your first token in the Playground (or directly via the API with the pre-filled parameters).

text: Sellers onboard by creating a service (name, type, pricing, identity requirements) and submitting it for Skyfire's approval
quote: Click Create Service and provide details like: name, type, pricing, identity requirements, etc. Submit for approval.

text: An official MCP server lets agents discover sellers, generate identity/payment tokens, and execute commerce workflows end-to-end

text: Sellers can publish an MCP Server Resource documenting which token types and headers are required for each endpoint

text: A single Know Your Agent (KYA) identity verification applies to both buyer and seller agents

text: Sellers can offer a guest-checkout flow to buyer agents using a combined kya-pay token
quote: Sellers can use a `kya-pay` token to enable a guest checkout experience for buyer agents.

text: Sites or bot managers can recognize a verified agent/platform and let it through instead of blocking it
quote: The site, or the bot manager in front of it, can then identify the agent/agent platform and allow it through rather than block it.

text: Signing up automatically creates a Buyer Agent with a pre-funded wallet ready to spend
